Update only the selected canonical paper pages and supplied comparison targets in the JSON input. Use the canonical pages and local source extracts first; consult the pinned originals when the extracts are insufficient. Apply the provided synthesis constraints. Do not ingest any more papers.

- Compare the papers on dimensions relevant to the work (for example task scope, interface, inputs, outcome checks, and evaluation limits). Add concise, cited comparisons to **Differentiators** and, where useful, to nearby **Why** or **Relationships** text. Distinguish direct use or evaluation from a contrast; shared subject matter, similar names, or a citation alone are insufficient.
- Add typed `relationships` in frontmatter only where sources support the link, using an existing canonical ID and a concrete reason. Follow `schemas/paper.schema.yaml`. Do not add self-links, duplicate entries, or automatic reciprocal links. Preserve accepted corrections, FAQ, and unrelated content. If stronger evidence is missing, leave the claim or edge out and report the gap. A verified no-change result is valid.
- Check the diff against the evidence and scope, and run `python3 -m harness.check_wikilint`. Report changed paths, omitted or unresolved comparisons, and exactly one standalone `SYNTHESIS_COMPLETE` line only after successful verification and validation.
